sections.overall: Darby Allin's rating has hit a new all-time peak! His match against Konosuke Takeshita (8.91) concluded a remarkable run of five straight 8+ rated World Title defenses. An incredible feat! However, the Collision main event vs Sammy Guevara (7.48), far from being below-average, was the lowest-rated so far of Darby's title run. Another defense on Dynamite and then the showdown with MJF at Double or Nothing... will that be the end of what is an already-historic run?
sections.mens: While Darby extended his lead at number 1, Takeshita gained the most places within the top 10: from #6 to #3: his career-best ranking! There were two main drop-outs from the Men's top rankings this week: Kenny Omega and Bandido. However, both are on the card for Double or Nothing, so expect to see their swift return to the top 10 next Wednesday. The most notable returns to the Men's rankings other than Guevara were Mark Briscoe (back in the top 10) and Brian Cage, though his TNT title match vs Kevin Knight (6.65) led to only a small gain and a long way off the top spots.
sections.womens: A return to the Women's rankings for Red Velvet in her TBS Title match against Willow Nightingale (6.85). With Williow's recent 'Comeback Killer' gimmick, will this be a start of regular appearances or a one off? I fear the latter is the case...
sections.menstag: Again, there has been little focus from AEW on the teams lately. In the Men's Tag, there were a few matches but none of which led to any notable gains or losses. The Young Bucks still head up the rankings... will this change after Double or Nothing, depending on the Stadium Stampede match that they feature in?
sections.womenstag: Another ineligible match for Divine Dominion... although it is always fun to see them dominate in squash matches, a plus-five-minute match would be welcomed! Sisters of Sin re-enter the rankings and reclaim the top spot from Shida & Statlander. Hopefully AEW will give the female wrestlers more opportunities, but how many times have we said this before?!
sections.trios: Re-entries for another Conglomeration combination and STP's Infanty & Moriarty, plus The Rascalz with a decent match (6.96) all featured this week. No major changes in the rankings.
